scope: Add a temporary browser workbook check to the local frontend, middleware and backend stack without changing research inputs or making a research decision.

architecture.frontend: frontend/ serves the dependency-free browser console
architecture.middleware: middleware/ permits only allowlisted local API routes and the configured frontend origin
architecture.backend: backend/ performs read-only checks in operating-system temporary directories
architecture.route: POST /api/v1/workbook/check accepts strict Base64 .xlsx bytes and optional request-only session-calendar or selection-manifest text

safety_boundaries: All three services and all configured inter-service endpoints are restricted to http://127.0.0.1:<port>.
The browser never supplies a filesystem path; uploaded workbook bytes are written only to a TemporaryDirectory and are not retained.
Decoded workbooks are limited to 20 MB; the workbook route has a 32 MB encoded-request limit and auxiliary text is bounded.
Malformed Base64, malformed workbook XML, invalid optional inputs and unsupported workbook structures return WORKBOOK_INVALID rather than a server error.
The API never writes the workbook, screening CSV, source packets, working copies or run directories.

coverage: frontend static console and local configuration
status, frame validation and frozen draw through middleware
real pinned workbook copy without source mutation
invalid Base64, invalid optional manifest and malformed workbook XML
allowlisted routes, preflight, origin checks and local-only connection enforcement

live_loopback_smoke.note: The temporary services were stopped after the check.

known_limits: This software check does not recalculate workbook formulas or certify formula behavior in Excel.
The supplied 114-scenario workbook suite was not rerun locally in this increment.
Excel compatibility, independent reviewer confirmation, measured 30-record screening time, real frame scope and case-specific market coverage remain open.
The browser layout was verified through local HTTP and automated flow tests; it was not accepted as a deployed web application.
publication: NOT_PUBLISHED; no GitHub push or external sharing
